summary:
This may be a good time to invest
Tanker prices have been trending down in recent months, even though freight rates in most tanker segments have been strong. This week, Poten assesses the contract price for a newbuilding VLCC at $90 million and a 5 year old vessel is valued at $74.5 million. Over the last decade, tanker prices have rarely been this low and this only happened when the freight market was depressed.
